successors.text: reintegrated into the Bosnia eyalet after Ali-paša Rizvanbegović's death

ledger.x: 1833: the Herzegovina Eyalet is created for Ali Agha Rizvanbegović as a reward for helping to crush the 1831 revolt of Husein Gradaščević.
1851: the eyalet is disestablished and reintegrated into Bosnia after Rizvanbegović's death; the page gives no year for the reintegration itself.

certainty.note: A list of kazas with no surveyed frontier; the Montenegrin frontier especially is approximate.
